programme.desc: 어느 날 갑자기! 세상 어디에도 없던 이상하고, 신기하고, 웃긴 방송국이 생겼다?! 재미있는 걸 찾고 있는 모두에게 열려 있는 내 손안의 방송국, 수상한 방송국!

programme.title: 세상에 나쁜 개는 없다
programme.desc: 문제 있는 반려견들의 행동을 알아 보고 원인을 찾아나가는 프로그램

programme.title: 세계테마기행
programme.desc: 세계테마기행은 단순한 여행 정보 프로그램에서 벗어나, 자유로운 배낭여행자만이 느낄 수 있는 살아있는 체험기를 전해드리고자 기획된 프로그램. 스페인에서 칠레, 남아공에서 알래스카에 이르기까지 전 세계를 직접 발로 뛰며 제작되는 세계테마기행은 찬란한 문명 유적지와 자연유산은 물론 다양한 방식으로 삶을 영위해 가는 세계인들의 숨은 일상까지 생생히 보여준다

programme.title: EBS 스페이스 공감
programme.desc: EBS Space에서 이루어지는 공연 실황을 엄선하여 방송하는 프로그램으로 현장의 생생한 울림과 감동을 시청자들에게 전달해주는 TV 속 콘서트홀이 될 것이다.

programme.title: 톡파원 25시
programme.desc: CNN에 특파원이 있다면 우리에게는 톡파원이 있다! 생생한 세계 각국의 현지 영상도 살펴보고 화상앱을 통해 다양한 톡파원들과 깊이 있는 토크도 나눠보는 톡파원 25시!

programme.title: TV 동물농장
programme.desc: 인간사만큼이나 무궁무진한 동물들 삶의 애환과 고뇌, 기적과 운명이 교차하는 동물의 세계를 그들의 입장에서 이해하고 공감하도록 유도하는 동물 전문 프로그램. 인간 중심의 사회에서 벗어나 인간과 동물의 진정한 교감을 통해 그들의 순수한 사랑과 감동이 함께 한다.

programme.title: 생방송 투데이

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 大漢盛世首
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 大盛魁

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 紫釵奇緣新
programme.desc: 紫釵一錯誤終身，才子佳人各天涯，情深難敵功名路，回首已成舊夢痕根據明代戲曲家湯顯祖的經典名著紫釵記改編而成，講述了大唐年間，歌舞名妓霍小玉風流俠客納蘭東書香才子李益和巾幗紅顏盧靖瀾為首的風騷人物，彼此錯綜複雜的命運與感情糾葛一場指腹為婚的誤會，造成浪漫卻無果的錯點鴛鴦，他們在階級差異與強權壓迫中勇於追求真愛，在宮廷權謀與世俗現實的拉扯中身不由己地被推向命運的叉路，自此展開一段關於愛背叛與救贖的傳奇故事

programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 大盛魁
programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 大漢盛世首
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 庖丁傳奇之金刀御廚
programme.desc: 民以食為天，八大菜系中佛跳牆之由來有各種傳説，本故事即以兩位廚師及其後人經歷各種磨難，涅槃重生，創造此經典閩菜之過程

programme.title: 本日公休
programme.desc: 阿蕊開了四十年的男士家庭理髮，面對生活的煩擾，阿蕊總是以台灣歐巴桑的精神面對人生有天阿蕊接到一通電話，搬到遠方的老客人生病無法出門剪頭髮，拜託阿蕊到府服務阿蕊想起師傅教她這一行要服務客人到底，於是掛上本日公休的牌子，她要出發去做一件所有人都認為不值得的事

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山間，一僧一道比鄰而居和尚隨和開朗，有一女徒菁菁玲瓏可愛；道士古板嚴厲，徒弟嘉樂卻鬼馬頑皮性格不同的兩個師傅口角不斷，兩個冤家徒弟也笑料頻出某天，一支邊疆皇族屍隊路過此地，遭遇暴雨雷劈，殭屍破棺而出，大開殺戒烏侍郎攜王子僥倖逃命，但王子已中屍毒和尚與道士命徒兒照看王子，兩人則衝入樹林尋找千鶴道長

programme.title: 山忌：黃衣小飛俠
programme.desc: 一旦遇見祂，將迷失於山中嘉銘玉欣和安偉是大學登山社的好友某次登山途中，他們意外迷失方向，儘管沿路綁上白布條作記號，卻不斷繞回原處，彷彿陷入無盡迴圈荒亂之際，濃霧中隱約出現一個身穿黃色雨衣的身影，讓三人燃起希望；沒想到，詭異現象卻接連發生，真正的噩夢才剛剛開始

programme.title: 頭七
programme.desc: 傳說亡者在死後第七天會回家道別與家人斷絕往來的春華因爺爺去世，迫不得已帶女兒沁萱回家，多年不見的家人依舊冷言冷語將母女視為空氣而老家中似乎還有其他人在，沁萱不斷聽到神秘耳語母女倆在老宅裡甚至做了相同的惡夢不受歡迎的母女倆決定待到頭七那天就走，然而頭七那天，回來的竟是

programme.title: 跛豪
programme.desc: 呂良偉飾演六年代香港黑道傳奇人物跛豪，他過去因曾遭到伏擊受傷變成跛子，號跛豪心有不甘的跛豪，設計陷害對頭肥波（鄭則仕飾），安排他藏有毒品入獄，再緊抓住探長的弱點，用黑錢賄賂他，使出一連串的計謀，剷除異己，整飭黑道，但終因得罪的人太多，事跡敗露，為人黑吃黑，即使探長想幫他，也礙莫能助

programme.title: 空中急診英雄：海空災難最終救援
programme.desc: 地下鐵事故三個月後，空中救援小組的藍澤醫生離別之時終將到來，成田機場卻發生緊急事故，位於東京灣的渡輪，又意外撞上休息站遭遇前所未有的航空與海上大事故，面對史上最險惡的災難現場，空中救援小組將該如何完成如此艱困的救援任務？

programme.title: 危城
programme.desc: 民國初年，時值中國內戰軍閥割據亂世時代，一個叫普城的偏遠城鎮，其治安由普城保衛團暫管由於軍閥少帥曹少璘（古天樂飾）殺害三條人命，普城保衛團團長楊克難（劉青雲飾）於是將曹少帥繩之於法，然曹軍財雄勢大，以強權震懾居民，曹軍上校張亦（吳京飾）得悉事件後，趕來普城取人，遇上多年不見之浪人師弟馬鋒（彭于晏飾）馬鋒路見不平欲拔刀相助，卻面臨正義與兄弟情之抉擇

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: 寧采臣是一名收帳書生，因雨被迫在一破廟留宿道士燕赤霞警告他儘快離開，寧未理會，後被古琴聲引至郊野而遇到女鬼聶小倩小倩為千年樹妖姥姥所控制，被迫引誘凡人予姥姥吸取元氣小倩為寧采臣真情所動，不願加害於他，然而姥姥欲將小倩嫁給黑山老妖寧采臣求助燕赤霞二人最終封印姥姥，又消滅黑山老妖，使小倩得以投胎轉世，燕赤霞亦決定回歸蘭若寺遠離塵世

programme.title: 龍虎門
programme.desc: 由王小虎王小龍和石黑龍三個熱血青年所創立的龍虎門武館，因一次誤取犯罪組織羅剎教權杖，成為眾惡霸的追擊目標，繼而展開一幕幕驚天動地的正邪對決改編自香港知名漫畫家黃玉郎作品

programme.title: 父子武狀元
programme.desc: 公安鞏偉瞞著妻兒混入犯罪集團臥底，並為辦案需要丟下病重的妻子和兒子小固，到香港經悍匪小黑介紹而獲黑道大哥賞識香港女督察方逸華前往北京調查鞏偉的身份，與鞏固漸生感情，在其母病逝後帶小固赴港尋父然警方卻以小固為餌欲引出鞏偉，鞏偉因而與方逸華交戰小固則被小黑救走，卻又被犯罪集團挾持，鞏偉和方逸華雙雙前往營救，與匪徒爆發一場激鬥

programme.title: 嚦咕嚦咕新年財
programme.desc: 德華和天樂是一對兄弟，以打牌為生的德華出名好牌技好牌品，與他相戀多年的詠琪因牌品差而始終未能結為連理，便詛咒他從此一世摸爛牌結果詛咒靈驗了，德華將所有財產輸給了青雲，但一向樂觀的他深信自己的好朋友終會回歸後來在天樂公司舉行的麻將大賽中一路過關斬將，與青雲再次對壘

programme.title: 新天龍八部之天山童姥
programme.desc: 巫行雲與李秋水互爭天山童姥之位，為了春秋所乘，幸在最後關頭，阿紫棄暗投明，與虛竹協助巫李兩人，卒能誅殺元凶，重建天山之祥和

programme.title: 大顯神威
programme.desc: 保坪宮第十八代師公王富貴（豬哥亮飾），人稱豬哥仙，實際上逢賭必輸，輸到攜家帶眷南下投靠有錢妹婿（黃明志飾），不料妹婿中風，王富貴因緣際會認識保坪宮第十八代繼承人龍老大（李李仁飾），還誤打誤撞遇見了美豔女鬼晴霞（安心亞飾），從此時來運轉，但請鬼拿藥單，總要付出代價的原來，晴霞30年前曾經是紅透半邊天的歌姬，卻為愛香消玉殞，含冤遊蕩在陰陽兩界這次找上豬哥仙，要他大顯神威，解開塵封多年的謎底

programme.title: 鬼們之蝴蝶大廈新
programme.desc: 為了逃離施暴的丈夫，陳薇帶著女兒搬進一棟頻繁發生墜樓自殺事件的老舊公寓蝴蝶大廈，管理員與住在頂樓的老廟公多次警告：有一層樓，千萬不要靠近陳薇逐漸察覺周遭異常，而那戶緊閉的613號房，更如黑洞般吞噬著她的神經，唯一帶來片刻安寧的，是時常上門關心陳薇母女的代理管理員小梁隨著農曆鬼月到來，蝴蝶大廈逐步陷入一場無形的詭異風暴

programme.title: 蝦米小白鯨
programme.desc: 這是年幼白鯨卡塔克的成長故事當卡塔克的同伴們都隨著年齡變為預期的白色時，卡塔克的發育卻顯得緩慢為了證明自己已經長大，並實現他所崇拜的奶奶的最後願望，卡塔克踏上了前往北方的危險旅程在途中，他遇到了致命的野獸，並結交了原本不可能有交集的朋友

programme.title: 五月的35日
programme.desc: 1940年，德軍佔領法國，從事記者工作的路德維希與他年僅12歲的兒子洛弗為了逃避納粹政府的通緝，已經在法國馬賽流亡三年，計畫帶著愛犬阿迪逃離歐洲前往紐約與妻子會合途中，兩人認識了與洛弗差不多大的牧羊女諾麗雅兒，三人一狗踏上了佈滿危險的未知旅程多項國際影展獲獎提名

programme.title: 神鬼戰隊
programme.desc: 特種部隊隊長塞達爾因遭遇伏擊而失去了16名士兵，被撤職以示負責，然而，政府正處於內外受敵的狀況，副國務卿提議組織一個特殊小隊來處理這些叛變狀況塞達爾被賦予隊長的任務，由傑出士兵和警察組成的特殊團隊（T..M），不管是內部叛徒或是外人，都必須全面肅清內外受敵，他們組成一支魔鬼部隊誓死抗敵！

programme.title: 星光首映場雷霆殺陣
programme.desc: 米榭爾維隆是個賽車天才，儘管家人持反對意見，米榭爾始終追求自己的理想，那就是一定要取得利曼24小時耐力賽冠軍憑藉著熱情與堅強體魄，以及冷靜的分析判斷能力，米榭爾終於拿到了這項比賽的冠軍一時媒體和車迷都奉他為世界賽車的未來天皇巨星就在各種鮮花喜悅包圍著米榭爾的同時，一場跨國的獵殺行動也悄悄展開

programme.title: 超級間諜
programme.desc: 一名迷人的男子在酒吧裡試圖搭訕一名興趣缺缺的女性，他捏造了一個關於間諜晶片植入以及一名正在追捕他的危險科學家的故事但若這一切都是真的呢？真正在搭訕的，又是誰呢？

programme.title: 黑獄戰場
programme.desc: 為了替遭殘忍謀殺的家人復仇，傑克不顧自己警察身分，精心策畫一宗銀行搶案，讓自己被送進兇手巴拉姆所在的監獄但傑克入獄後才發現，巴拉姆早已掌握整座監獄的運作，在牢中享有帝王般的待遇，更受到獄方層層保護，而巴拉姆得知傑克入獄，也派出殺手欲置傑克於死地，正當孤立無援的傑克無計可施之時，FBI臥底威廉提出兩人聯手對抗巴拉姆的計畫究竟威廉真正的意圖為何？傑克又能否殺出重圍，一償復仇宿願？

programme.title: 自由協議
programme.desc: 七年前，賽德為了替死去的兄弟報仇，與哥本哈根黑幫開戰後入獄警方向賽德提出交換條件，要求賽德成為哥本哈根黑幫臥底，以換取獲釋機會為了與日漸疏遠的7歲兒子修復關係，賽德同意了警方的條件，卻逐漸意識到作為黑幫臥底，也同時嚴重危及兒子的生命安全

programme.title: 人生消極掰
programme.desc: 大學教授理查，某日被醫生診斷只剩六個月可活絕望的他回到家，正打算告訴妻女這件事時，卻反而得知妻子出軌女兒出櫃再次遭受打擊的他，在大罵人生真該死之後，決定拋棄一切道德束縛盡情享受越亂越快樂的人生他開始瘋狂酗酒吸毒濫交，狂野舉止讓妻女都傻眼不已不過他這堂放飛自我不合常規的另類人生課程，卻意外啟發他眾多學生

programme.title: 異世界的奇幻漂流
programme.desc: 充滿想像與創造力的她，與學校生活格格不入，在參加木偶才藝競賽時卻意外降落到異世界，熟悉的奇幻氛圍跟腦中想像不謀而合，邪惡女巫甜美戀愛刺激冒險，全由自己撰寫

programme.title: 零重力空間
programme.desc: 在伊拉克的一場激烈交火後，渾身是傷的士兵睜開眼，發現自己身處一個詭異的立方體裡，沒有窗戶或出口酷熱與嚴寒交替襲來，重力忽上忽下，牆壁上還浮現出奇怪的文字手邊衛星電話響起，一位神秘的女人聲稱自己也被困在一個類似的空間裡隨著時間一分一秒流逝，立方體不斷變化，挑戰著兩人的極限他們必須竭盡所能與時間賽跑，逃離各自的立方體

programme.title: 地球殞落
programme.desc: 巨大小行星行經太陽系，其引力猛然拉扯地球導致天崩地裂身為無名小卒的他想盡辦法要與妻女團聚，卻意外發現政府的秘密機構，從而揭開美國政府的驚人計劃

programme.title: 邊防戰區
programme.desc: 一名駐紮在阿富汗的年輕荷蘭士兵，其隸屬車隊在戰區遭到炸彈攻擊，他朝一名阿富汗嫌犯開槍，但是他萬萬沒想到，這件事很快就引發了一連串的危機，並讓這場炸彈攻擊的倖存者留下了一道無法抹滅的陰影

programme.title: 午夜密令
programme.desc: 1939年夏天，一間位在英國南部海岸專收納粹高官女兒的奧古斯塔維多利亞女子學院，嚴格遵循著希特勒的納粹思想英籍校長羅喬爾僱用英籍教師湯瑪斯米勒作為臨時教師；湯瑪斯並在校長與其他德籍教師們的監視下，教導這群女孩練習英語這時，校園中出現一位前任教師的屍體，也讓湯瑪斯陷入致命危機

programme.title: 玩命快遞：肆意橫行
programme.desc: 法蘭克馬丁卸下特務身分後，轉行成為地表最強送貨員，他的客戶通常是身分可疑的危險人物，不過他從不過問交易細節拿錢辦事而且絕對使命必達當退休的特工老爸來到南法找他時，原以為可以再續父子天倫之樂，沒想到老爸卻涉入蛇蠍美女安娜與其美麗同夥策劃的銀行搶案，法蘭克必須用他非凡身手與飛車絕技，救回最珍貴的家人！

programme.title: 我的老爸喵星人
programme.desc: 老爸不是人，變成喵星人！商業大亨湯姆狂熱於工作事業而疏忽家庭關係當得知女兒蕾貝卡11歲生日最想獲得的禮物是一隻貓，湯姆便來到寵物店挑選，但回程途中發生意外，湯姆竟被困在貓的身體裡，並由自己的女兒蕾貝卡收養湯姆開始體驗到除了財富之外，人生的另一種價值

programme.title: 北極戰隊
programme.desc: 北極狐史威帝在北極物流公司的收發室工作，但他有著遠大的夢想：希望有朝一日能成為頂尖的北極快遞員為了證明自己的能耐，史威帝自告奮勇運送一批神秘貨物，卻意外發現海象奧托的邪惡計畫，他與手下們打算釋放地底下的古代氣體，讓北極完全融化史威帝與他的好友們組成一支臨時戰隊，要阻止奧托的可怕陰謀！

programme.title: 催眠狙擊
programme.desc: 剛復職的警探丹尼洛克在調查一宗銀行搶案的過程中，發現一名具有強大催眠能力的危險男子，竟和自己日前離奇失蹤的女兒有關在催眠師黛安娜協助下，他嘗試追查並拆解箇中謎團，反而讓他們被該男子追殺而身陷險境，事情發展出人意料，顛覆他對身邊一切的認知

programme.title: 狂人法則
programme.desc: 川普瘋狂事蹟全揭露，川普法律團隊揚言提告的爭議之作！年輕的川普為了擺脫房地產大亨父親所帶來的陰影，立志要在曼哈頓房地產業界闖出名聲因緣際會之下，他結識了惡名昭彰的律師羅依科恩科恩看中川普的潛力，教導他邁向成功的狂人法則兩人透過無所不用其極的瘋狂行事，成功讓川普的房地產事業崛起

programme.title: 從你的全世界路過
programme.desc: 陳末每天和王牌DJ小容針鋒相對，誰也不知道他們的仇恨從何而來陳末的兩個兄弟分別是全城最傻的豬頭，跟全城最純的茅十八，每天橫衝直撞的三人，都遇到人生的轉捩點失去所有的他們，弄丟了自己的出路，直到聽見來自世界的一段語音

programme.title: 偷龍轉鳳
programme.desc: 妮可是巴黎著名的邦尼家族千金，但邦尼家族私下係以偽造名家藝術贗品為樂巴黎一所博物館將舉行藝術品展覽，妮可的父親受邀參加，然而其中被視為偉大傑作的維納斯雕像，其實是她祖父製造的贗品，投保一百萬美元不料，保險公司要求技術鑑定，眼看事蹟即將敗露，妮可只得聘請一位高明神偷賽門偷走雕像

programme.title: 殲滅戰1941
programme.desc: 改編自二戰哈薩克名人阿迪沙里波夫的真實故事阿迪沙里波夫中尉與他的軍團在敵軍戰線的包圍下撤退未知的恐懼襲來，他們意識到毫不作為的等待將會比敵人的子彈更加致命

programme.title: 外太空九號計畫
programme.desc: 由於地球政府不願承認外星人的存在，並研發可能摧毀宇宙的太陽彈，於是外星指揮官啟動外太空九號計劃，準備讓活屍大軍進攻球所幸奉命調查的美軍上校轄區警長與目擊民航機師三人，與外星人在飛碟機艙內打鬥而造成失火，最終導致飛碟在逃離地球時於空中爆炸，這才適時解除危機！

programme.title: 黃飛鴻對黃飛鴻
programme.desc: 一代宗師黃飛鴻因佛山無影腳出名後不堪煩擾一日，省城謝老爺邀請飛鴻同為災民籌款，飛鴻在廣州邂逅了武藝高強的奇女子雙番東，引發連串荒謬場面偶然間飛鴻得悉原來謝老爺假籌款實斂財，於是登門興師問罪，竟發現謝老闆找來雙番東反串假扮黃飛鴻與自己對質？於是黃飛鴻對黃飛鴻好戲上演！

programme.title: 英雄訣57-58完首
programme.desc: 英雄訣57-58完首

programme.title: 馬里蓋拉：革命先鋒
programme.desc: 1969年，巴西的頭號全民公敵馬里蓋拉沒有時間害怕一方面，暴力軍事獨裁政府的拷問刑求令人髮指，以及用惡名昭彰的審查制度控制言論自由；另一方面，對於反對的異議人士極盡恐嚇威脅之能事有著一群比他年輕30歲的游擊隊們願意跟隨他戰鬥，革命領袖馬里蓋拉試圖說服民眾必須起義雖然更想與兒子共聚天倫，他卻只能奮力而戰，捨生取義

programme.title: 荒野大鏢客
programme.desc: 位處美墨邊境荒涼的墨西哥小鎮，來了一位總是叼著根雪茄煙槍法神準的大鏢客鎮上有巴特幫洛荷幫兩大幫派，專門販賣私械私酒，兩幫長期廝殺，魚肉鎮民，弄得鎮民們是妻離子散，家破人亡出於正義，大鏢客運用計謀讓雙方展開火拚，最終將小鎮的惡勢力全數消滅

programme.title: 赤狐書生
programme.desc: 清貧書生王子進赴京趕考途中，遇見下凡取丹的小狐妖白十三白十三為了晉升狐仙，假意陪王子進趕考，實則要讓王子進主動獻出丹前往京城的路途遙遠又充滿危險，一人一狐相互扶持共患難，成了莫逆之交歷盡萬險，終於到了白十三在友情與成仙之間作出抉擇的時刻

programme.title: 時光機器
programme.desc: 19世紀的英國發明家喬治搭著自己發明的時光機器前往未來，期盼未來會是和平世界，但實際上卻戰爭不斷當他來到最遙遠的未來，發現此時只剩下生活在地面的艾諾伊族，與生活在地底並以艾諾伊族為食的莫勒克族喬治挺身帶領艾諾伊族反抗，並協助他們重新建立文明

programme.title: 香米小情歌
programme.desc: 年輕貌美的美國科學家琳達被公司派往印度銷售她所培育的9號稻米初次來到印度的琳達飽受文化衝擊，遇到一位因為繳不出學費而輟學的大學生羅傑，兩人卻在研究與爭執過程當中陷入熱戀，羅傑也幫她發現被派往印度的醜陋內幕，原來她想要幫助印度農民的研究成果，竟不知不覺地被無良公司濫用，即將對農民造成毀滅性的傷害！琳達該要如何阻止這場災難？而她與羅傑的異國戀又將會開花結果嗎？

programme.desc: 英雄訣57-58完

programme.title: 異域2：孤軍
programme.desc: 泰北孤軍奉國民政府命南撤至緬甸泰國寮國邊境後，開始在燥濕的環境下，自行開闢村落生活有人四處流竄變成土匪，有人則跟當地政府妥協

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記首
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 被告人首
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版新
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 被告人

programme.title: 雲襄傳完
programme.desc: 陳曉攜手毛曉彤闖江湖，智武雙全亂世見真情！！雲襄背負雲台門使命開始於江湖中走盪，因意外結識瀟灑帶勁的俠女舒亞男等其他能力之士而成為好友一同在波譎雲詭的江湖紛爭中成長理解仁德與尋找正義眾人尋覓禍亂天下的陰謀逐漸明朗時，雲襄決定挺身而出捍衛一切，守住天下大義

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 羅美蘭化身高年級實習生 道盡女性職場家庭壓力曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手如今成為上司的崔智媛在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.desc: 羅美蘭化身高年級實習生 道盡女性職場家庭壓力曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手如今成為上司的崔智媛在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.desc: 好鄰居少女陳慧郭奕芯飾搬入工廈劏房.熱心準備喬遷派對認識新鄰居,卻介入了被虐少女Emma鮑康兒飾和她男友的關係中.靈異事件接連發生,背後卻是最現實又可悲的真相......二重身因為對愛情的執著,讓少女綺雯許雅婷飾刺上催情改運符咒刺青,希望男友家洛麥子樂飾回心轉意.誰知卻誤墮紋身師阿森張建聲飾與其老婆Jenny蔣祖曼飾的陰謀之中,怪事連連,每日過著人...

programme.title: 聖戰風雲粵普

programme.title: 大丈夫 2粵普

programme.title: 八寶奇兵粵普
programme.desc: 匪幫首領李大東被女幹探常洛紅打至重傷,逃至廣州招攬前公安福摩斯,莊勁等七人,企圖返港進行連串械劫案.訓練期間,七人偷偷往舞廳見識,結交了黑社會頭目天九,並得悉大東的真正陰謀.此時,他們也揭發女教練原來是警方臥底探員.為救女教練,七人施展混身解數,八寶盡數,合力對抗大東與其匪幫...

programme.title: 行運一條龍粵普

programme.desc: Turning his attentions to timber structures from the Middle Ages the former steeplejack visits Englands oldest fortified building with a moat, Stokesay Castle. programme.title: Operation Grand Canyon with Dan Snow
programme.desc: Part one of two. The broadcaster joins a team of historians and geologists to recreate a pioneering 280-mile journey through the natural wonder that was led by explorer John Wesley Powell in 1869. Following in Powells footsteps in the stunning yet challenging north Arizona landscape, Snow and the crew take on the areas rapids in antique wooden boats as they learn about the regions geological and Native American past

programme.title: Lost Home Movies of Nazi Germany
programme.desc: Part one of two. Thousands of German attics have become dumping grounds for countless hours of private home movies, left gathering dust for decades and now giving an insight into the innermost recesses of life in Nazi Germany. This programme delves into these private collections, which are only now emerging, to reveal how Germans recorded the regime, featuring films from ordinary citizens as well as Nazi Party organisers, firemen, local officials and soldiers on the frontline

programme.title: Spencer Banks Remembers - Pendas Fen

programme.title: Ultras
programme.desc: A look at what the future holds for the culture, examining if it could evolve into something sustainable and accountable, or what could replace it if shut out. Clubs like Kilwinning are fed up, citing safety concerns and financial survival, while others argue that engagement is the only realistic future

programme.title: Growing Up Scottish
programme.desc: Comedians and entertainers including Ashley Storrie, Stuart Mitchell, Marjolein Robertson, Susan Riddell, Patricia Panther, Alison Peebles, Maureen Carr, Rachel Jackson, Jamie MacDonald and Bruce Devlin discuss music. They cover the artists, the hits, the gigs and the festivals, and assess the highs and lows of starting a band and using a cassette player

programme.title: The Secret Letters of Mary Queen of Scots
programme.desc: Katie Leung narrates the story of amateur codebreakers Satoshi Tomokiyo, George Lasry and Norbert Biermann who collaborated across continents to decipher a mysterious cache of coded letters from the 1570s and 1580s, discovering they were from Mary, Queen of Scots. The unlocked letters bring new insights into her long years of captivity in Elizabethan England, her power plays, complaints and clandestine methods for communicating with her followers. Set against Marys dramatic journey - from infant queen, through civil war, abdication and years of captivity - the film examines the lengths Mary went to conceal her words and the ingenuity needed to decode her letters today, even with the help of 21st-century computing

programme.title: The Young Offenders
programme.desc: Conor and Maireads much-loved fridge finally gives up on them. programme.title: The Young Offenders

Dr Erin Lloyd Jones visit the ruins of the ancient abbey at Strata Florida and Jonny Cotsen meets military veterans who have taken up art

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: An update on Hazel, the first southern koala born in Europe. Theres another milestone for this precious baby, she has to be separated from her mother by the keepers for a short period. This is to ensure the keepers earn the babys trust before she becomes impossible to work with. Their intention is to separate Hazel from her mother for 10 minutes without distressing either of the animals. Plus, a specialist osteopath attends a monitor lizard suffering a worrying issue with his spine

programme.title: Who Do You Think You Are?
programme.desc: Ralf Little heads to the Orkney Islands off the north coast of Scotland to investigate his grandfather Arthurs experience during the Second World War. He is astonished to discover that Arthur was caught up in one of the most important battles of the war. On another branch of the family tree, Ralf is thrilled to confirm a family rumour that he is linked to a Welsh international footballer - his great grandfather. On returning to his home town of Manchester, the actor is delighted to learn that his four-times great grandfather played a key role in the industrial development of the city

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team of experts visit Scarborough, North Yorkshire, where some of the more unusual items include a rare roll of Beatles wallpaper, a passport that once belonged to the worlds smallest man and carved whales teeth that turn out to be very valuable

programme.title: Flog It!

programme.title: Clive Myries Caribbean Adventure
programme.desc: Clive visits the district of Vedado, the most modern and affluent part of Havana. He takes a motorcycle tour with Ernesto Guevara, Che Guevaras son and finds out how to cook a feast under rationing. Plus, Clive stretches himself with a lesson in ballet at Carlos Acostas school and learns how to make a Cuban cocktail

programme.title: Today at the Test
programme.desc: England v Pakistan. Highlights of day one of the Third and Final Test in the series from Edgbaston in Birmingham. programme.title: Inside the Factory

When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him-only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrates daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Muis embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlongs younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of Infernal Affairs are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sams wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiaos spirit is revived to take revenge when the dolls eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Clouds successor as the citys guard.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tians daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Maybe Its Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchants mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperors eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: An Inconvenient Tooth Up, Up and Away
programme.desc: After Lula loses her loose tooth in the park, Team Zenko must find the missing molar and get it under Lulas pillow in time for the Tooth Fairys visit. Gabriel and Luis show off their new drone but it crash lands on the roof top. Team Zenkos mission is to try and get it back, but Yolanda wont give up her new hi-tech friend that easily.

programme.title: Scare Scouts Boo
programme.desc: Scare Scouts When Frankengymteacher forms a scout troop, Casper is the first to sign up. Boo! During a visit to Deedstown, Casper and his friends are shocked to find the humans dressed as scary creaturesit must Halloween!

programme.title: Abra-Ca-Deedstown Shrinky Dust
programme.desc: Abra-Ca-Deedstown From cleaning Ras sarcophagus, to starring in Jimmys magic act, Casper has been helping so much, hes exhausted. Shrinky Dust When magical Shrinky Dust falls into Norman the bullys hands, Casper and Jimmy find themselves on a hunt to get it back.

programme.title: Abra-CAT-Dabra
programme.desc: Baby Box is learning to be a great magician and wants to pull a rabbit out of a hat. But when theres no rabbit to be found, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box visit the other Gabby Cats for help. For the COTD, Baby Box, Gabby and Pandy sing the Whoopsies! Song.

programme.title: Mailed Away The Wandering Wand
programme.desc: When Harper unknowingly drops her cooking camp application on the way to post office, its up to the Dew Drops to get it into that big blue mailbox. When Cassie accidentally places Lolas beloved, old toy wand in a box marked for a giveaway drive in the park, the Dew Drops must find a way to retrieve the wand before it ends up in the hands of an entirely new family.

programme.title: Lucky Penny Hammys Day Out
programme.desc: Marcus has a piano recital and unknowingly forgets his lucky penny at home. Now its up to the Dew Drops to get the penny across town and back into Marcus pocket before showtime. When Nicholas rolls the hamster ball with Hammy inside out into the streets, the Dew Drops must get Hammy back home safely.

programme.title: Moms Birthday Angry
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop enlist Cruzs help to perform a dance for Moms birthday. Though its hard at first, they learn to put their dolphin, unicorn, and narwhal powers together to create something special. Kelp, Pixie, Ollie, and their friend Leroy try to help Juniper understand her angry feelings.

programme.title: Tuskist Three Moon Festival
programme.desc: Scallop is afraid of her first tuskist appointment. Kelp helps her get through it with a song. Fog rolls in, threatening Kelps first Three Moon Festival in Unicorn Land. Kelp and his friends use a combination of unicorn spark and the Kelp Way to create a new festival.

programme.title: Ding Dong Day Grand Sam
programme.desc: Its Pawstons annual Take Your Kid to Work Day, and its Tags year to spend the day at the Doorbell Store with Paw. Sam Whippet challenges the Not Yet Cadets to complete an obstacle course in the woods.

programme.title: Clucky Day Take Me Out to the Fetch Game
programme.desc: Scooch is bummed out because hes missing his favorite holiday back in his old farm town, so Tag wants to cheer him up by rounding up some chickens and bringing Clucky Day to Pawston. When theres a schedule mix-up and the Pawston Get Sox players think they have a day off, its up to Tag and Scooch to round up all five players in time for the fetch game, so that they dont have to forfeit.

programme.title: Boo to You
programme.desc: Burple gets spooked by the legend of a ghost called the Phantom Fang. But when he senses the story is real, he cant get his friends to believe him.

programme.title: Where Theres Smoke
programme.desc: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

programme.title: A Fang-Tastic Halloween
programme.desc: After hearing spooky rumors about the new habitat resident- A BAT- Marty is determined to protect his friends from the newcomer. But when the bat helps him out of a tough situation, Marty learns its better to get to know someone rather than judge them on false stereotypes.

programme.title: A Tale of Two Kitties
programme.desc: Alex is mistaken for a Maine Coon and takes over that cats life in the penthouse. At first, VERY comfortable with his shmancy new life, Alex grows to miss his old life and learns that its lonely at the top.

programme.title: Prank Day Adventures In Dinkles-Sitting
programme.desc: When Branch declares himself Prank Master Poppy gets evenTaking care of Mr. Dinkles is a bit harder than expected for Securityobsessed Branch.

programme.title: Eyell Be Watching You Sorry Not Sorry
programme.desc: Convinced Troll Village is dangerous Branch makes a security plantPoppy creates an apology monster out of Gristle when teaching him how to make amends.

programme.title: The Knights Fall Part 1
programme.desc: Po and Blade rush to warn the Emperor about the weasels, but he has Po arrested and Colin captures Blade, revealing that she was never a knight. Thrown in a cell, Po reunites with Rukhmini and Mr. Ping, and he copes with the truth about Blade as they break out. Po fights Klaus and Veruca but is outmatched. Blade defeats Colin and hurries to help Po but is too late.

programme.title: The Knights Fall Part 2
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blades life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

programme.title: The Liar and The Thief
programme.desc: The team arrives in India where an old friend of Rukhmini can supposedly give them a pendant that will lead to the next Tianshang weapon. But when they arrive, they find that Rukhminis hometown has changed a lot in the thirty years shes been gone, and her old friend Diya might not be willing to help them.

programme.title: Wrinkles Stickles
programme.desc: After Turtleneck is captured by Frederic Estes, Boss Baby and Tim attempt to rescue her, leading them to the terrifying fun house at the town fair

programme.title: Bossa Nova
programme.desc: After Boss Baby is fired from Baby Corphe attempts to navigate regular baby life in a MommyDaddyBaby playgroup. Even worsethe playgroups other new member is Mega Fatwhose animatronic stuffie Wagby malfunctions and threatens the safety of the whole group. MeanwhileTim does everything he can to avoid doing his homework.

programme.title: The Museum Job
programme.desc: When the crowded bathroom situation at the local museum threatens baby loveBoss Baby leads his new team of playgroup babies on their first missionand then their SECOND mission after a klepto baby in their group swipes a priceless artifact. In a continued attempt to avoid homeworkTim joins Boss Baby on his mission.

programme.title: Return of the Four Constellations
programme.desc: The kids go to the Spirit Realm and meet the Original Four Constellations in the hopes of learning how to defeat Jindiao

programme.title: Unholy Dragon Returns to the Mountains
programme.desc: Jindiao takes Po and the kids hostage in an attempt to locate the Wellspring

As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀Glory of Love

programme.title: 卧底娇娃Pretty Dangerous
programme.desc: 新型毒品粉精灵在城市蔓延，卧底警察潘奕风为彻底摧毁毒品网络，与另两名女性组成卧底小组三人分别擅长推理武术与伪装，以参加女团选秀为掩护，潜入犯罪组织在执行任务中，她们面临身份暴露的危险，但逐步揭开更大的幕后势力故事融合卧底动作与喜剧元素，在轻松与紧张交织中呈现一场惊险的缉毒行动As a new drug Pink Spirit spreads across the city, undercover officer Feng and her all-female team go undercover as girl group contestants to infiltrate a drug syndicate led by a philanthropic couple, only to uncover a larger criminal conspiracy.

programme.title: 夏日奇妙书My Marvellous Fable
programme.desc: 实习编辑冯天蓝加入出版社的第一份任务就是去催畅销作家王葡萄的稿件，而她交稿的条件就是让冯天蓝从北京开车送她回老家琼海！在回乡的旅程中，王葡萄开始说一些真假参杂的故事，冯天蓝在整理书稿中拼凑出了王葡萄的人生，而王葡萄也在创作中反思自我两个心中有伤的人展开了互相治愈的浪漫奇幻之旅

programme.title: 爱情有烟火Love Has Fireworks
programme.desc: Xinyou sends key evidence. Qian Fei returns to the project in a minor role, while Li Yifei takes on the risk of confronting Shanlifangs problems and continues protecting her.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀Glory of Love
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性借由三个女主角来传达自信勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking ones unlimited potential.

programme.title: 百味人生Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. programme.title: Saat Hilang Cintamu
programme.desc: Razil, seorang suami sejati, cintanya kepada Salina tidak pudar walau dia diselingkuhi dan menceraikannya. Dengan rela dia kekal dekat dengan anak-anak dan tinggal di pondok kecil juga sanggup menjaga isterinya selepas kemalangan tragis. Kisah berasaskan kisah benar ini mengundang emosi mendalam.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Haziq meluru keluar dari kereta apabila melihat Aisyah jatuh dan tangan Aisyah luka berdarah. Manakala Iskandar hanya duduk di dalam kereta dan tidak menghiraukan apa yang terjadi. Haziq menawarkan pada Aisyah untuk pergi ke klinik, belum sempat Aisyah bersetuju Iskandar sudah keluar dari kereta dan marah disebabkan menunggu. Aisyah terkejut dengan sikap Iskandar lalu menolak perlawaan Haziq. Aisyah memberitahu Ros tentang Iskandar dan Ros menganggap bahawa lelaki kaya seperti Iskandar tidak pernah peduli akan perasaan sesama manusia tetapi hanya pada harta. Kepulangan Aisyah di rumah dalam keadaan tangan yang luka membuatkan Fasha lebih suka mengenakan Aisyah. Dia meminta Aisyah melakukan segala kerja meskipun kerja itu sudah diselesaikan oleh Aisyah awal pagi lagi. Mak su Ainin akan sentiasa menjadi penyokong Fasha dalam membuli Aisyah. Sementara itu, Tengku Maria begitu marah dengan kepergiaan Iskandar yang meninggalkan TG Holdings semata mahukan ketenangan selepas Tengku Maria memaksanya berkahwin dengan Tengku Waiduri. Tengku Maria meminta Iskandar balik dengan segera jika mahukan jawatan CEO TG Holdings itu diserahkan padanya. Namun Iskandar berdegil dan mahu Tengku Maria membatalkan niat untuk menyatukan Tengku Waiduri dengannya. Hubungan tegang antara Tengku Maria dan Iskandar membawa malapetaka pada Iskandar apabila dia hampir terlanggar Aisyah yang ketika itu sedang berlari dalam hujan akibat mahu menyelamatkan diri daripada diperkosa oleh Farid.

programme.title: Secebis Rindu
programme.desc: Rasya Aleeya hadir dalam satu majlis prom night. Rasya Aleeya berjalan sendirian dengan memakai dress hitam dengan rambut panjang dilepaskan. Wajah Rasya juga ditutupi dengan topeng muka. Semua hadirin memakai topeng menutupi wajah. Rasya Aleeya terus berjalan. Seorang lelaki Syed Reeza memakai topeng muka mengajak Rasya menari. Rasya belum bersedia untuk berjumpa dengan mana-mana lelaki. Rasya takut ekoran rasa panaroid. Rasya teringat lagi semasa mama tinggalkan dirinya.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Sakinah memberitahu anak-anak beliau yang Alawiyah akan nikahkan Qasih dengan anaknya Jazlan lalu menasihatkan mereka untuk pandai mengambil hati ibunya, Alawiyah. Alawiyah berasa sungguh hairan kerana setiap hari menerima bungkusan untuk Jazlan dari bidadri dunia. Jazlan terjumpa Qasih yang tersidai tepi jalan akibat kereta beliau rosak lalu terpaksa bantu menghantar Qasih ke kolej. Alawiyah dan Khatijah akan mencadangkan kepada anak-anak mereka untuk bertunang sebelum Jazlan ke Madinah

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah rebah di dalam hujan. Iskandar meminta Haziq untuk membiarkan Aisyah pengsan bersendirian tetapi sekali lagi Haziq memaksa Iskandar untuk bersikap perikemanusiaan. Iskandar mengalah dan mereka terpaksa membawa Aisyah ke homestay mereka untuk di rawat. Di homestay mereka buntu bagaimana untuk menguruskan Aisyah yang masih pengsan. Haziq meminta Iskandar menjaga Aisyah sementara dia pergi memanggil empunya homestay iaitu kak Wan. Belum sempat kak Wan dan Haziq tiba di homestay, orang kampung sudah tiba dahulu di homestay itu dan menangkap Iskandar dan Aisyah yang sedang berdua. Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha memarahi Farid kerana mahu merogol Aisyah. Takut diketahui orang ramai, Mak Su Ainin yang melihat kejadian Aisyah berlari keluar kerana hampir dirogol oleh Farid itu terus membuat perancangan mengenakan Aisyah bagi menutup malu. Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha dan ke homestay dengan berpura-pura sedih dan kecewa atas kelakuan Aisyah. Aisyah dan Iskandar menafikan mereka berkhalwat, penjelasan demi penjelasan di berikan namun tiada siapa yang percaya. Mak Su Ainin meminta Aisyah dan Iskandar berkahwin pada malam itu juga.

programme.desc: Deanna mencuba pelbagai idea gila bagi mencari pengganti untuk pengantin lelaki. Dalam masa yang sama, katerer pilihan Deanna pula mahu menarik diri dan Khai terpaksa membuat satu tawaran yang mustahil akan ditolak.

programme.title: Secebis Rindu
programme.desc: Rasya minta tempoh untuk berfikir sebab tak nak kecewakan opah yang susah payah menjaga dirinya. Reeza Rasya pula semakin mesra. Reeza teman Rasya beli kereta. Fahmi dapat tahu Rasya nak beli kereta. Fahmi offer diri nak teman tapi Rasya mengelak. Reeza dan Rasya terserempak dengan TA TM di sebuah restoran.

programme.title: Black S1 EP2
programme.desc: Pegawai penguatkuasa undang-undang Bunian 444 atau juga dikenali sebagai Black sedang diburu kerana rakan setugasnya seorang penderhaka, 419, telah melarikan diri ke dunia manusia. Menyedari 419 telah menghuni tubuh manusia, Black memutuskan untuk memasuki tubuh Malik untuk bersaing dengannya. programme.desc: Detektif Khairul Malik menyimpan sebuah rahsia, yang teman wanitanya, Aisya tidak tahu mengenainya. Apabila dia meramal sebuah tragedi dahsyat, Sofia mendapat perhatian polis dan juga seorang keturunan usahawan insurans ulung, Lokman Nazir. Tertarik dengan bakat unik Sofia, Malik meyakinkan dia untuk bekerja bersamanya untuk menyelamatkan nyawa, tetapi niat baik mereka menyebabkan tragedi. Sementara itu, penghantaran sebuah pita menyebabkan huru-hara dalam hubungan Malik dan Aisya apabila rahsia gelap Aisya mula terungkai.

Meskipun begitu, satu lagi kes pembunuhan yang mengerikan telah berlaku, sama seperti kejadian baru-baru ini. Nampaknya mangsa seperti ada kaitan dengan Aisya. Lelaki dengan wajah berparut muncul untuk menyeksanya ... siapa dia dan kenapa Aisya mengikut arahannya? Sofia dapat tahu yang mungkin ayahnya telah dibunuh dan ini membawanya kepada CEO Insurans Mahkota, Lokman Nazir, yang boleh mendapatkan fail lama ayahnya ... dan mungkin menjadi petunjuk kepada identiti pembunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Jiwa Taiko
programme.desc: Kesilapannya mungkin menyebabkan dia dipenjara, tetapi bagi Firman, ia juga menjadi pemangkin permulaan baru dalam hidup. Trisya seorang gadis yang mendambakan untuk dicintai, tetapi apabila bertemu dengannya barulah dia sedar bahawa cinta sejati bukanlah hamparan bunga mawar. Freez adalah seorang lelaki yang riang yang hanya berfikir tentang melepak dengan rakan-rakannya dan menjadi gembira, manakala Lara adalah seorang yang bersemangat bebas yang mahu membuat jalannya di dunia sendiri. Mereka berempat bertemu di Wira Cinta, sebuah kelab yang dimiliki oleh Kak Pora di mana mereka semua belajar seni mempertahankan diri dan juga mengenali diri mereka sendiri, apabila Pinto, abang ipar Firman dari masa lalunya yang kelam muncul di kelab itu dan menuntut bahawa Firman kembali kepada kumpulan itu atau menghadapi akibatnya.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP11
programme.desc: Cikgu Zaiton pengsan selepas ternampak lembaga seakan-akan Wan Peah di hadapan rumah Cikgu Siti semasa pulang dari kedai. Tok Hashim kemudiannya mengadakan sembahyang hajat dan doa selamat. Mak Timah dan Cikgu Zaiton tidak habis-habis menyalahkan Cikgu Siti yang kononnya memakai menyebabkan huru-hara di kampung mereka. Selepas solat hajat, Nurin yang merasa bersalah mengaku dialah yang menakut-nakutkan Cikgu Zaiton pada malam tersebut. Farhan semasa berkelah dengan Cikgu Siti dan 3 sahabatnya di Bukit Berapit mendapati Aishah tiba-tiba hilang.

Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Kau Langit Aku Laut
programme.desc: Kau Langit Aku Laut mengisahkan pasangan kekasih yang mempunyai banyak perbezaan dan sering bergaduh. Mereka cuba pertahankan hubungan walaupun banyak cabaran dan salah faham.

programme.title: 7 Days24 Hours
programme.desc: Mengisahkan pasangan suami isteri, Tania dan Tyo, yang terlalu sibuk dengan kerjaya sehingga hubungan mereka semakin renggang. Selepas kedua-duanya jatuh sakit dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital yang sama, mereka akhirnya mempunyai masa bersama selama 7 hari 24 jam untuk memperbaiki hubungan, memahami satu sama lain dan menghadapi masalah yang selama ini dipendam.

programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kejadian sebenar tentang Hind Rajab, seorang kanak-kanak perempuan berusia 6 tahun yang terperangkap di dalam sebuah kereta di Gaza dan membuat panggilan kecemasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan. Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.

programme.title: Diari Abah
programme.desc: Rahmat dipulaukan oleh tiga anaknya, Annur, Zarif Zakuan, setelah berkahwin buat kali kedua dengan Ashikin, ibu tunggal anak satu. Anak-anaknya menganggap kematian ibu mereka, Khalijad berpunca daripada keputusan Rahmat berkahwin lain. Namun mereka semua tersedar apabila Ashikin telah menyerahkan sebuah diari kepada mereka bertiga setelah Rahmat meninggal dunia. Tercatat dalam diari itu bahawa segala duit yang dikirimkan setiap bulan digunakan abah mereka untuk mendirikan rumah anak yatim atas permintaan arwah ibu mereka dengan nama Rumah Anak Yatim Cik Khalijah.

programme.title: Me VS Mami
programme.desc: Mira terpaksa menemani ibunya, Maudy, dalam satu perjalanan jauh untuk menziarahi neneknya yang sedang tenat. Sepanjang perjalanan, hubungan mereka yang sering dipenuhi pertengkaran diuji melalui pelbagai cabaran dan pertemuan baharu, sehingga mereka akhirnya saling memahami dan mengeratkan hubungan sebagai ibu dan anak.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Kasih Seorang Ayah
programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminahayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. programme.title: Her Railway Trip
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestantsHo Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-szeset aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various outdoor experts on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong wild women with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: The Truth Within
programme.desc: Haunted by his girlfriends suspicious death in a car crash, young forensic examiner Qi Sizhe transfers to a major crimes unit to find the truth. Teaming up with detective Zhu Qingyue and officer Han Feng, he investigates a series of bizarre murders. Through forensic evidence, they discover that every crime connects to an illegal synthetic drug ring called Original Diamondthe masterminds behind his girlfriends death.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING TONG MICHAEL. CHORs voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HOs future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HOs heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba is forced to work at home during COVID-19 and fights with his family every day. He decides to turn his mothers chilli sauce into a trendy commodity to keep his family occupied. With his mother, father and aunt making the chilli sauce together, the family sells it online and the business grows beyond their imagination.

programme.title: Panda Plan
programme.desc: After legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts the panda Hu Hu, an international crime syndicate places a massive bounty on the bear. Joined by his agent and Hu Hus caretaker, Jackie embarks on a daring quest to outsmart the villains.

programme.title: Our Crazy Adventures
programme.desc: Before graduation, five high school friends - Jia Yi, Kopi, Uncle, Wawa and Ah Di - decide to do something unforgettable together. Chasing dreams, friendship and youthful passion, they take on a seemingly impossible challenge, winning a crucial basketball game that could change their lives and shape their future forever.

programme.title: Shock Wave
programme.desc: Bomb specialist Cheung Choi San sets out to capture a wanted criminal called Blast. However, will he be able to do it in time before Blast kills hundreds of citizens inside Hong Kongs busiest Cross Harbour Tunnel and destroys everything in his quest for revenge?

programme.title: Welcome to My Side
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs and murders the cops. Inspector Bong is devastated to see the aftermath of the carnage and soon discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him. As the two men meet again, it is time to settle the score

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: The sequel to Table for Six, Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive?

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from Tos father and bitter jealousy from her designated fianc, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his fathers will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met. When Pan discovers that his daughter is being abused by Hua, he vows to save her but eventually fall into their trap

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Office lady Zhou Ran falls victim to an online dating love scam and is cheated of 550,000 yuan. Following faint clues left by the scammer, Zhou Ran comes to a small coastal town and encounters two young men. She gradually discovers that these two men have hidden the clues of the scam, and sets out on her revenge plan.

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: A retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian man who carries a bag of stolen drugs. Forced to live together, the two men transcend conflicts and cultural differences to form a beautiful friendship in this poignant tale of loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Silent Code
programme.desc: Reporter Lan is tasked to research news from the internet, and stumbles across a popular BBS forum, Dream Board. The forum founder Xiang, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas, but ends up being the subject of a heated debate due to a leaked video. As Lan digs for the truth, she finds that things more complicated than they seem...

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: In this epic action-thriller starring Andy Lau and Louis Koo, the two award-winning best actors star on opposing sides of a drug war. As a bounty of 100 million Hong Kong dollars is made to hunt down the biggest drug dealer in the city, Hong Kong becomes the battleground for the fight between good and evil.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperors Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Kingdom And The Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry himonly for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: Hex vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrates daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Muis embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlongs younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: The Adventures Of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during Chinas early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.
